loop: gauntlet: a builder and a separate critic with fresh context per piece. The critic runs ours next to native, names the biggest gap, and the piece loops until the critic picks ours.

items.title: #7 chunking, hashing and block store
items.detail: Round-2 findings N1-N8 fixed, re-verified by me: 89 crate tests pass, fmt/clippy clean, scope clean, BlockId/ChunkRef untouched, CI green. items.title: #11 Linux FUSE mount
items.detail: Critic findings fixed, re-verified by me at 98c0f24: 43 unit tests on Mac, and in the Linux VM 46 unit + 39 mount + 5 regress tests pass, no mounts left. Defaults now safe: ttl 1 s, keep_cache off, opt-in SoleWriter with an Invalidator; Vfs panics become EIO then a clean unmount; keyed-lane worker pool (slow read no longer delays stat: 856 ms to 0.2 ms, builder's n=1); signal cleanup and stale-mount sweep; inode-reuse paranoid mode. Decisions for lead: cross-adapter permission policy (FUSE denies later O_WRONLY on a 0444 file, NFS allows), SoleWriter wiring by core/control plane (invalidate from outside Vfs calls), add 'Ino never reused' text to architecture doc (done on v1/vfs-trait), add a Linux mount CI job (command in report). 2 survivors: one equivalent, one control. | Builder done and verified by me at 98c0f24 (CI green). items.title: #12 macOS NFS loopback mount
items.detail: Reply-cache connection bug FIXED and re-verified by me at 5122ff1 (110 crate tests, 5 new dupcache tests, ignored mount suite 17/17, no mounts left, CI green). Round-2 critic verdict: NOT mergeable with Translate as default. F1 ._x created before x exists (unzip exits 50, tarfile and ditto fail, git clone with tracked ._ files leaves a broken index; Hide and Store succeed); F2 a write to a real ._x file is accepted then lost after restart; F3 more than ~150 xattrs on a file make all its xattrs invisible (fix patch provided). Also: sidecar handles do not go stale on inode reuse, concurrent sidecar writes lose chunks, silent connections fill the cap, one-shot MNT can be raced by a polling attacker, SIGKILL of the host hangs ls/touch, inline_metadata stalls the server with a blocking Vfs, RPC claim not reproduced (14.3 to 13.4, not 19 to 13), 14 of 24 new-code mutants killed. Held up: SETATTR guard correct, reference balance 0 leaks in all 3 modes, handle MAC sound, RSS bounded (3-24 MiB), SIGTERM cleanup 66/66. Builder switching default to Hide first, then fixing Translate. | Round-2 fixes in progress (head 954f6ee). Live CI red on both platforms at the clippy step (mid-edit). Default AppleDoubleMode must be Hide until Translate passes the archive-extraction and git-clone tests.

items.title: #26 cowfs-core: Vfs over store and meta
items.detail: Critic verdict: NOT mergeable. F1 deadlock: ensure_file holds the node write lock then takes the meta read lock while commit holds meta write then node read (repro hangs; builder's stress/kill9 never hit it). F2 promote_base removes base then forks: a failed fork loses base. F3 one corrupt block wedges the whole snapshot (fsync, readdir, fork, merkle_root all return Corrupt; other files' acked data lost at reopen) and a partial overwrite inside a corrupt chunk succeeds. Also: virtual inos reused across restart (wrong bytes), snapshot names accept .git/newline/ESC and case/NFC duplicates unlike the CLI, readdir flushes unrelated dirty data (48 MiB, 179 ms), alias table unbounded (469 MB after 500k creates), zero-id hole refs look dangling to GC. Held up: durability ordering, fsx 20k ops vs model, 60 s of overlapping writers (0 torn), hook failure recovery, EIO on corrupt reads. Bench (load 11-15): seq read 1351 MiB/s (13.6x slower than APFS page cache), 4K read 21.6k/s, seq write+fsync 390 MiB/s, lookups faster than std::fs. Builder fixing and re-merging fixed store and meta. | Critic fixes in progress (head ed46c84, CI not yet reported): lock-order deadlock, promote_base loses base, corrupt block wedges a snapshot, ino reuse across restart, snapshot name rules, alias table bound. Re-merges store and metadata (metadata is now on main).
